risk_review.notes: Native Alpha40 completed the adopted postulate formulation, physical scope, compact closed planar support, observation geometry, SI units, non-derivation and source review; its report left this risk review open solely for the two actual outgoing-kernel prerequisites. Current focused review reread the full unchanged postulate and all ten pertinent direct interfaces: omega>0 and c>0 give k>0; for x3>0 and y3=0, R>=x3, so |G_k(x-y)|<=1/(4pi x3). Finite total variation gives L1(|alpha|) membership for the Borel bounded-on-support kernel and |u(x)|<=||alpha||TV/(4pi x3), using the general integral definition. Zero alpha is allowed even though S is nonempty; compact support may include closed-radius corners. Alpha data in volts and G in inverse metres give u in V/m; half|u|^2 has squared-field units and is adopted only for comparisons, without absolute radiometry. Countable Choice is inherited; the boundary supplier full-Choice modal branch is not used. Neither vacuum Maxwell branch nor the material closures derives the scalar aperture datum or identifies it with exact unknown screen traces; independent u and normal-derivative assignment remains outside the claimed exact boundary problem. The corrected current outgoing supplier now declares general complex integration and exact exponential/addition/Euler/derivative interfaces, with complete R2 Lipschitz argument for either sign/zero phase; its public Statement is unchanged, its contract is integrated and scoped checks passed. This removes the only native Alpha hold and preserves off-support regularity, closed r>=2a, outgoing residual and Fresnel/Fraunhofer error content. Native Alpha reports independent Beisert14.1-14.3 passage reading; this closure reviewed that native evidence, not a fresh complete-book reading. BYU retrieval failed in native Alpha; edition and locators were not independently validated and are not used to establish the local mathematics. No empirical calibration, apparatus/sampling law, measured-intensity or exact vector Maxwell validity is inferred. This is focused prerequisite closure and accurate risk metadata, not an independent whole-book/corpus audit, additional carrier repair cycle, budget reset or gate authorization.
